_comment: Generated by ck-mcp/admin_powers.py for the admin panel Powers tab. Names are editor ids. spells is EMPTY on purpose (17 Oct: Give all spells froze the server, an N squared spell-list read fixed by fork d780bb9a). The catalogue (every spell, power and lesser power a winning spell tome teaches in the live order, without mod internals or the removed and suspended spells) waits in spellsMeasureFirst, which nothing reads: the batched action (rc-1026-fork 68d0b736) reads spells and falls back to spellsGiveAllOff, so the list stays out of both until give-all is measured on dev (the Leader, 26 Oct); renaming spellsMeasureFirst to spells turns it on. spellSources counts it by plugin (gamemode-config giveAll.spellSources narrows it). shouts is EMPTY too; the 27 a player learns are in shoutsGate, which combat.js reads for the player shout gate. Rename a list back into spells or shouts to re-enable the old unbatched path - deliberately, with the code change.
